provenance.temporal_composition: all source notes; release-capped audible intervals; conflicting same-string targets rejected
provenance.geometry_frame: caller supplied guitar frame; delta meters and relative velocity meters/second
provenance.priority_slots: current with earliest end; unmatched nearest nonexpired strict deadline within token window

layout.mapping: reviewed tablature and left-hand finger mapping

song.derivation: supported onset=canonical score+traversal; alternate_restrike split at source note_on; each split inherits aggregate direction; end=min(sustain,release); no source-origin shift; +policy pre-roll; horizon=ceil((audio+pre-roll+tail)*60)/60
song.direction_scope: aggregate plan direction inherited independently by each split note; second direction is not inferred
